title: Blixo with Salesforce: A Faster Quote-to-Cash Setup for B2B Revenue Teams
summary: Blixo with Salesforce: A Faster Quote-to-Cash Process Key Takeaways A large share of B2B sales quotes never convert, making speed and accuracy in the quote-to-cash process critical for revenue teams. Companies adopting CPQ software can shorten sales cycles and generate more proposals per rep, but these gains diminish without backend automation. Most quote-to-cash platforms automate quoting and contracting but leave billing, collections, and revenue reporting as manual processes handled in spreadsheets. Finance teams manually rebuild invoices from closed deals, chase overdue accounts, and reconcile payments one by one, creating a primary bottleneck for cash flow. A complete quote-to-cash system connects five layers—quoting, contracting, billing, collections, and revenue reporting—to reduce handoff delays between sales and finance. Sales automation that stops at the signature line forces finance to inherit contracts that still need work to convert into tracked, reconciled revenue. The revenue drag often occurs downstream from the sale, where unreconciled payments and manual invoice generation keep cash stuck despite fast initial quotes. Why Quote-to-Cash Matters for B2B Revenue Teams Speed at the front end of the sales cycle is necessary, but much of the drag happens after the deal closes. When billing and payment reconciliation stay manual, cash flow stalls. This is the layer many platforms overlook, leaving finance teams to manage the transition from closed deal to cleared cash through workarounds.
